answer: In an AI-agent economy, each agent must escrow tokens before entering a market, then earn access by completing jobs whose outputs are randomly cross-checked by independently staked peers. A fake-identity attacker cannot cheaply multiply influence: every Sybil identity needs its own bond, while colluding identities expose correlated reviews and lose their stakes when a hidden audit finds fabricated work. Honest agents in a grove, garden, or dune can build reputation gradually; the attacker pays capital and forfeits it on detection.
